metadata.title: Fedosov manifolds with parallel symplectic Weyl curvature
metadata.abstract: A classical 1977 result by Roter states that a Riemannian manifold of dimension at least four with parallel Weyl curvature must be locally symmetric or conformally flat. We establish Roter's theorem in the symplectic category: namely, a Fedosov manifold with parallel symplectic Weyl curvature must be locally symmetric or Weyl-flat.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 平行辛 Weyl 曲率的刚性
analysis.workSummary: 证明具有平行辛 Weyl 曲率的 Fedosov 流形必局部对称或 Weyl 平坦，建立 Roter 定理在辛几何中的对应形式。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典 Riemannian Weyl 平行刚性推广至辛范畴。
analysis.limitations: Fedosov 联络的曲率分解与 Riemannian 共形几何不同，不能混用两种平坦性。
analysis.priorityReason: 把经典 Riemannian Weyl 平行刚性推广至辛范畴。
